intent_en: Compare unfair-stop rates for Black men, Black women, and Black adults overall.
narration_support: almost half of Black adults said that this had happened to them, including about two -thirds of Black men.
chart_support: Bar chart comparing the percentage of Black men, Black women, and Black adults who say they have been unfairly stopped by police, showing Black men have the highest proportion.
evidence_note: The narration provides specific prevalence estimates (almost half for adults, about two-thirds for men) that correspond to the chart's data for Black adults (45%) and Black men (64%). The chart title explicitly states the main comparative finding.
narrative_goal: To demonstrate that Black men are far more likely than Black women to report being unfairly stopped by police due to their race or ethnicity.
current_model_input: Compare unfair-stop rates for Black men, Black women, and Black adults overall.
